_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 30d momentum and funding pinned mid-band inside a 14% coil with cancelled upside/downside tells; HOLD is the graded base-rate call until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: No—analyst explicit HOLD (illegal Complacency target corrected to ±1); narrative silent on forward phase; lean analyst
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound with 30d momentum near 50, funding near flat, and Fear & Greed holding mid-range
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum leaves 40-60 with funding and Fear & Greed breaking same direction, or VIX/gold spike with CVD rollover
